obligations.title: Deliver an independent penetration test summary and remediation summary for material findings.
Report any Security Incident within 24 hours and provide information to investigate, contain and remediate it.
Report any personal data breach within 24 hours and cooperate on the Customer's notification and remediation duties.
Make Customer Data available for export on expiry or termination, then securely delete it.
Keep the other Party's Confidential Information confidential for 5 years after the Agreement ends.
Try in good faith to resolve disputes through senior executives before court referral.
